summary: Pilot MTT formalization of Chatzikyriakidis & Luo 2020 ch. 4 (§4.2 gradable adjectives, §4.3 gradable nouns): Degree as a Tarski universe of names (HEIGHT/AGE/IDIOCY) with decoding D(d):=nat; polymorphic standard STND over degree-indexed CNs and syntactic adjective types ADJ; tall and taller_than as inequalities against STND (4.27); Idiot as the nested Sigma-type of (4.33); enormous per (4.35); enormousidiot as a coercion Record transcribing (4.36) with the book's STND(ENORMOUS) >= STND(IDIOTIC) side condition as a conjunct. Five small Qed theorems: two comparative sanity checks (TALLER, trans) and three consequences of the enormous-idiot construction (ENORMOUS1, EI2, EI3), of which EI3 is vacuous — its section hypothesis STND_order is refutable by self-instantiation (proved in audit).

sources.citation: Chatzikyriakidis, S. & Luo, Z. (2020). Formal Semantics in Modern Type Theories. Wiley/ISTE. Ch. 4 'Advanced Modification', §4.2 (eqs. 4.17-4.27) and §4.3 (eqs. 4.31-4.36).
Chatzikyriakidis, S. & Luo, Z. (2013). Adjectives in a modern type-theoretical setting. (antecedent account the book's §4.2 builds on, with C&L 2014/2017a)

definitions_mapped.coq: Inductive Degree := HEIGHT | AGE | IDIOCY; D (d:Degree) := nat
definitions_mapped.source: universe Degree of totally ordered degree types (Height, Weight, Idiocy, ...) — §4.2 p.82
definitions_mapped.note: Tarski-universe encoding (names + decoding family, flagged in the file header); but D is constant — every degree type IS nat, so distinct dimensions are definitionally intercomparable (fn. 9 sanctions Height=Nat, not the全 collapse); AGE declared and never used (artifact ii)

definitions_mapped.source: universe CNG(D) of D-indexed CNs with introduction rules, subtype of CN — §4.2 p.82
definitions_mapped.note: the indexed-CN universe is collapsed to Set with a vacuous index: membership is unenforced (any Set is a CN_G of any degree), which is what lets IDIOTIC : ADJ IDIOCY Human typecheck (artifact ii/iv)

definitions_mapped.coq: Parameter Human : CN_G HEIGHT; Parameter height : Human -> Height
definitions_mapped.source: Human : Height -> Type indexed by heights; height(i,h) = i — (4.18)-(4.19)
definitions_mapped.note: the section's signature move (CNs indexed by degree) is dropped for the adjective half: unindexed Human plus an opaque measure function replaces the indexed family whose height is the index projection

definitions_mapped.coq: tall h := height h >= STND HEIGHT Human TALL; taller_than h1 h2 := height h2 > height h1
definitions_mapped.note: content of (4.27) with the Height index dropped; taller_than's argument order is reversed relative to (4.23) (internally consistent throughout the file)

definitions_mapped.coq: Parameter ADJ : forall d, CN_G d -> Set; TALL SHORT : ADJ HEIGHT Human; IDIOTIC : ADJ IDIOCY Human; ENORMOUS : forall d, ADJ d (PHY d); STND : forall d (A:CN_G d), ADJ d A -> D d; PHY : forall d, CN_G d
definitions_mapped.source: ADJ(A) syntactic adjective types with TALL : ADJ(Human); STND : PiD:Degree. PiA:CNG(D). ADJ(A) -> D (4.26); PHY_D : CNG(D)
definitions_mapped.note: up to an explicit degree index on ADJ; all are signature Parameters with no propositional content

definitions_mapped.coq: Idiot := sigT (fun x:Idiocy => sigT (fun y:IHuman x => x > STND IDIOCY Human IDIOTIC)); Parameter IHuman : Idiocy -> CN_G IDIOCY
definitions_mapped.source: Idiot = Sigma i:Idiocy. IHuman(i) x (i >= STND(Idiocy,Human,IDIOTIC)) with IHuman : Idiocy -> Type — (4.33)
definitions_mapped.note: nested Sigma for Sigma-times; strict > substituted for the source's >= (moves borderline cases); note the file keeps the book's own loose use of Human (a HEIGHT-CN) in the Idiocy-standard, typable only because CN_G's index is vacuous

definitions_mapped.coq: enormous (d:Degree) (A:CN_G d) (d1:D d) := fun P:A => d1 > STND d (PHY d) (ENORMOUS d)
definitions_mapped.source: enormous : PiD. PiA:D->CNG(D). Pid:D. A(D) -> Prop; Enormous(D)(A)(d)(a) = d >= STND(D,PHY_D,ENORMOUS) — (4.34)-(4.35)
definitions_mapped.note: the source's printed type does not typecheck (A : D -> CNG(D) applied as A(D)); the file substitutes the evident repair with the A-argument vacuous, as in (4.35); > for >=

definitions_mapped.coq: Record enormousidiot := { h :> Idiot; EI : enormous ... /\ STND IDIOCY (PHY IDIOCY) (ENORMOUS IDIOCY) >= STND IDIOCY Human IDIOTIC }
definitions_mapped.source: Enormous Idiot = Sigma h:Idiot. enormous(pi1 h, ...) where STND(D,PHY_D,ENORMOUS) >= STND(Idiocy,Human,IDIOTIC) — (4.36)
definitions_mapped.note: Record-with-coercion for the Sigma-type; the book's side condition internalized as a conjunct with the book's own >=; verbatim unused duplicate enormousidiot1 is dead code (added)

definitions_mapped.coq: Section Variable STND_order : forall d C A, STND d (PHY d) (ENORMOUS d) > STND d C A
definitions_mapped.source: over-generalization of (4.36)'s single side condition to all degrees/CNs/adjectives
definitions_mapped.note: REFUTABLE: instantiating C := PHY d, A := ENORMOUS d gives STND > itself; audit proved STND_order -> False from the bare signature. The source's own instance is consistent; the file's generalization is not. Only EI3 depends on it

definitions_mapped.source: CN_PHY subtype universe and polymorphic tall over it (4.24)-(4.25); §4.4 multidimensional adjectives (4.39)-(4.46); the section's stated provable claim (height(h1) >= height(h2) /\ tall(h2) -> tall(h1))
definitions_mapped.note: the subtype-universe machinery (Maclean & Luo 2020) has no Coq counterpart (artifact iv)

theorems.name: TALLER
theorems.source_claim: new (worked numeric example in the spirit of §4.2's comparatives: taller_than Mary John /\ height Mary = 170 -> height John > 170)

theorems.name: trans
theorems.source_claim: new (transitivity of taller_than; the book's explicitly stated easy claim — tall monotonicity after (4.23) — is not the one proved)

theorems.name: ENORMOUS1
theorems.source_claim: consequence of (4.36): an enormous idiot yields an idiot whose degree exceeds the ENORMOUS standard

theorems.name: EI2
theorems.source_claim: consequence of (4.33)+(4.36): the degree also exceeds the IDIOTIC standard, via the record's >= side condition (the book's own condition)
theorems.note: does not use STND_order; assumptions all signature-level

theorems.name: EI3
theorems.status: proved but vacuous — excluded per rubric §3
theorems.source_claim: strengthens EI2 with strict STND(ENORMOUS) > STND(IDIOTIC)
theorems.note: carries the discharged hypothesis STND_order, refuted in audit (self-instantiation C:=PHY d, A:=ENORMOUS d gives n>n); inconsistent-hypothesis theorem, a finding not a result

evidence: Print Assumptions on all five theorems (rerun in audit, Coq 8.20.1) lists only the ten signature Parameters (Human, John/Mary/Kim, height, PHY, ADJ, TALL/SHORT, IDIOTIC, ENORMOUS, STND, IHuman) — zero propositional axioms; STND_order is a discharged section Variable appearing only as EI3's hypothesis.
Idiot and enormousidiot transcribe (4.33) and (4.36) recognizably, including the book's STND(ENORMOUS) >= STND(IDIOTIC) side condition as a record conjunct.

Two core definitions are changed: CN_G(d) := Set collapses the indexed-CN universe (index vacuous, membership unenforced), and unindexed Human + opaque measure function replaces the Height-indexed family (4.18)-(4.19) that is §4.2's signature move.

The section's one explicitly stated provable claim (tall monotonicity from height comparison) is absent, and EI3 rests on the refutable STND_order (audit lemma STND_order_inconsistent, Qed, signature-only assumptions).
simplifications: all degree types decoded to nat (fn. 9 sanctions Height=Nat; the file extends this to every degree, conflating dimensions)
strict > substituted for the source's >= in Idiot, enormous, EI theorems
degree index on tall/taller_than dropped; taller_than argument order reversed (consistent)
omissions: CN_PHY subtype universe and the polymorphic tall of (4.24)-(4.25)
additions: unused AGE degree and Age type

determination_rationale: On this file's evidence only a partial formalization exists with core definitions changed: the account's load-bearing machinery is a hierarchy of universes (Degree, CNG(D) with introduction rules, the CN_PHY subtype universe) that Coq lacks natively, and the file responds by collapsing CN_G to Set (class ii artifact) and every degree type to nat, and by replacing the Height-indexed Human family with a measure function. What survives the collapse — STND polymorphism, the Sigma-type Idiot, the enormous-idiot construction — does go through constructively with zero propositional axioms, and its consequences (ENORMOUS1, EI2) are proved from the signature alone, so the Sigma-type analysis of gradable nouns itself is not the obstacle; the universe infrastructure is. A deeper encoding (or a substrate with coercive subtyping and subtype universes, i.e. the authors' own Plastic/UTT setting) could plausibly lift this to slight modification; this pilot does not establish that. EI3's vacuity is a file defect, not a theory defect: the source's own side condition is a single consistent instance, and the file's generalization to all adjectives is what refutes itself.

artifact_classes.description: CN_G(d) := Set — the degree-indexed CN universe collapsed to Set with a vacuous index (membership unenforced; IDIOTIC : ADJ IDIOCY Human typable only for this reason); D(d) := nat identifies all degree types with nat, making cross-dimension comparisons typable that the source's typing forbids; Degree itself is a Tarski name-universe workaround for Coq's lack of user-declared universes

no coercive subtyping or subtype universes: the CN_PHY analysis of polymorphic tall (4.24)-(4.25) is omitted; Record with :> coercion simulates the Sigma-type-plus-subtyping reading of (4.36); the book's CNG introduction rules and CNG(D) <= CN subtyping have no counterpart

source_gap.detail: The book's (4.34) prints enormous : PiD:Degree. PiA : D -> CNG(D). Pid : D. A(D) -> Prop, applying A to the degree type D rather than to a degree — it does not typecheck as written; (4.36) likewise prints the unbalanced application enormous((pi1(h), pi2(pi1(h))). The file substitutes the evident repair (A : CN_G(d), argument of type A vacuous), matching the intent of (4.35).

notes: Record produced by the batch audit sweep of 2026-09-05; the file predates the atlas zero-axiom discipline (10 signature Parameters plus one section Variable, though none is a propositional axiom and Print Assumptions is clean). Audit-specific finding: STND_order is inconsistent (proved during audit), so EI3 is vacuous and the effective proved count is 4 of 5; also note the >/>= substitutions and the dead duplicate enormousidiot1. File is 72 lines, header-free by atlas standards (no SOURCES block, no assumption-audit part).
